verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. On Android, Gemini can look at what's on your screen. With permission, Connected Apps lets it act inside other apps, such as editing content or creating calendar events. The Mac app is a chat window opened by a keyboard shortcut. None of this documents Gemini seeing and operating desktop applications on your computer. Missing for 10: documented desktop/computer-use control of local applications (clicking, typing, navigating UIs), screen viewing on a computer rather than an Android phone, task-completion workflows across local apps, and independent hands-on corroboration.
